problem: Web pages made by AI coding assistants tend to look generic and machine-made. Hallmark is a design skill that helps assistants produce pages that look designed.

stack.frontend: Generated self-contained HTML and CSS pages
stack.backend: Node.js scripts (theme dealing and a linter called sloplint)
stack.ai: Skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode, with subagent review
stack.deploy: Agent skill package (npm files) installed into coding assistants; a small static site served with Python

whatsNew: It deals three themes from a catalog of fifty, builds the hero alone, then lints the page in a real browser at eight widths against rules that catch common AI design tells. A subagent then reviews it with fresh eyes.
